title: Monitor Log File
description: Monitor a log file for a configurable error pattern.
script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

LOG_FILE="${1:-/var/log/syslog}"
PATTERN="${PATTERN:-ERROR|CRITICAL|FATAL}"

if [[ ! -f "$LOG_FILE" ]]; then
    echo "ERROR: Log file not found: $LOG_FILE" >&2
    exit 1
fi

echo "Searching $LOG_FILE for: $PATTERN"

if grep -Ein "$PATTERN" "$LOG_FILE" | tail -20; then
    echo "Matching log entries found."
else
    echo "No matching entries found."
fi
